title: Leaders eye deep EU budget cuts, while long-term joint borrowing becomes the new normal
lede: As leaders gather in Brussels, they must decide whether to keep pretending each new loan for Ukraine, defence, or other shocks is a one‑time exception, or finally admit that long‑term, risk‑managed joint borrowing has become the EU’s new normal.

title: EU and Turkey explore closer trade ties to reduce dependence on China
lede: The EU may not want Turkey as a member, but both sides can see the appeal of closer economic ties to reduce their dependencies on China.
